purpose: Real electrical state-change and persistence positive control using human-corrected appliance transitions. Transitions are not faults and no fault metric is permitted.
license_evidence: IEEE PES Data Sharing registry lists CC BY 4.0; Nature data descriptor and OSF public release provide the measurement and label provenance. Checked before performance on 2026-08-21.

chronological_split.ordering: Sort unique source days by documented UTC/local timestamp; preserve all records of a day together.
chronological_split.guard_band: Exclude the final 24 hours of fit and calibration from transition scoring to prevent boundary leakage. The guard does not move days between partitions.
chronological_split.failure: If timezone, day order, or date continuity is not documented, stop as NOT_EVALUABLE_CHRONOLOGICAL_SPLIT.

score_windows.transition_window: From 5 seconds before to 60 seconds after the documented transition onset, after resampling to the coarsest selected source-native aligned rate.
score_windows.baseline_window: The preceding 60 seconds, only when no documented transition intersects it.
score_windows.event_score: Maximum selected candidate score in the post-onset 60-second interval.

matched_controls.eligibility: Same appliance and same source day; equal-duration window; no documented transition in the window or in a 120-second exclusion buffer; candidate selection is independent of scores.
matched_controls.selection: Order eligible windows by SHA-256(appliance_id + day_id + transition_id + ':v14-c-control:' + seed) and select the first.
matched_controls.failure: Unmatched events remain unmatched; if <80% of confirmatory transition clusters have valid controls, return NOT_EVALUABLE_MATCHED_CONTROL_COVERAGE.

comparator: Maximum absolute first difference of the same selected source-native active-power/current channels over the same score window.
calibration_selection: Select candidate/threshold by calibration transition coverage at the frozen 60-second window; ties select higher threshold then PMC-C3, PMC-C2, PMC-C1.

independent_unit.prohibited: Waveform rows and resampled observations as independent outcomes.
independent_unit.uncertainty: 2,000 two-way day/appliance cluster bootstrap draws; fewer than 20 eligible confirmatory transition clusters returns INSUFFICIENT_CLUSTER_COUNT.

primary_gate: At least 20 eligible confirmatory transition clusters and >=80% valid matched controls. Support is positive-control-only even if all metrics favour the PMC candidate.
